settings.title: PREMIUM HANDWOVEN COCO MATS - 1.5" THICK
settings.text:
Our premier 1.5” thick handwoven coco doormats are the ultimate choice, with a dense weave packed full of coco fiber.

Sustainably produced, they provide double the fabric of BR quality mats, creating a luxurious and compact design.

settings.title: HANDWOVEN COCO MATS - 1" THICK
settings.text:
These 1” thick handwoven coco mats offer a smaller rendition of our Premium counterparts.

While thickness marks a significant contrast, these mats also showcase a handwoven braid along the edges, crafted entirely from sustainably sourced coconut husk fibers.

settings.title: VINYL BACKED COCO DOORMATS - 5/8" THICK
settings.text:
Our modern coco doormats feature eco-friendly coco fibers embedded in PVC vinyl backing.

This sleek design effectively scrapes away dirt and debris while preventing water leakage.

settings.text: Contact us to get a customized doormat just for you!

settings.subtitle: Durability and Performance
settings.title: Built to last
settings.text:
Crafted with 70% PVC vinyl yarn and a 30% polyester core, these doormats are designed to withstand daily wear and tear. The embossed heavy-duty tufted vinyl ensures durability while maintaining a sleek and stylish appearance.

With resistance to mold, mildew, and stains, these mats are perfect for high-traffic indoor spaces like entrances, laundry rooms, and playrooms, providing both functionality and style.

settings.subtitle: Personalized Elegance
settings.title: Custom Indoor Mats
settings.text:
Make your entryway truly yours with personalized designs. Each doormat features a customizable border pattern that enhances its aesthetic appeal while reflecting your unique style.

Whether you choose a festive theme or a classic look, these mats bring an elegant touch to your home, perfectly tailored to your taste.
